cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; a domed planetarium lounge during an early stargazing breakfast — she breaks a round bread roll in half and studies the spiral of its crumb with quiet amusement before taking a bite; the boarding stairs of a small plane on a sunny airfield — pulls a hard-shell travel suitcase along behind her by its handle; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a quiet tidal observatory with a narrow saltwater wading basin — she draws a small circle in the damp salt crust on the rim of the basin; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a steel catwalk high inside a giant hangar — crouching down low; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — reclining on her back; a hot-spring town footbath under a wooden roof — standing with one foot up on a step; a moonlit forest glade carpeted with softly glowing mushrooms and flowers — reads a glowing spellbook with drifting rune light held open in both hands; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated on a chair; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — hides her smile behind a white feather fan
